Package `@xberg-io/sdk`. Every method below is on the client; the async client in Python
mirrors the sync one method for method.

## Extraction

Submit documents and wait for results.

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `extract` | Submit a single document for extraction. Returns the initial {@link Job} |
| `extractBatch` | Submit multiple documents in a single multipart request. Returns one |
